skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental and specialized knowledge about business law, including legal regulations for business establishment and management, legal frameworks for different types of businesses, and laws related to dissolution and bankruptcy.
Develop the ability to independently research, accumulate, and enhance knowledge.
Demonstrate effective communication, presentation, and public speaking skills.
Analyze and solve problems related to business law and legal regulations.
Understand and apply legal compliance in business operations.
